sofia.title: Sofia — AI Agents for Operations and Sales
sofia.description: My own product in development: AI agents to schedule, sell and close orders on WhatsApp and Instagram, connected to a back office with calendar, order Kanban, catalog and CRM.
sofia.overview: Independent product of my own, built from scratch and still in development, not yet released to production. Sofia goes beyond a chatbot: its AI agents carry out real business actions inside WhatsApp, Instagram and the Web Inbox, connected to a management back office, and the platform is designed for companies in several segments, such as clinics, restaurants, consultancies, e-commerce and service providers. It is multi-tenant and adapts behavior, screens and tools to each company's niche. When needed, the conversation moves to the human team without the customer having to repeat anything.
features: Agent with tool execution (function calling) — Queries real-time data, applies business rules and validates constraints
AI models — LLM for conversation and function calling, tuned to reduce latency and cost
Audio — Transcription of voice notes received on WhatsApp and Instagram
Scheduling — Checks each professional's calendar, respects durations, breaks and holidays, and books, reschedules or cancels
Conversational commerce — Catalog with photos and add-ons, shipping calculation, cart and order closing in the chat
RAG knowledge base — Embeddings and semantic search on a vector database over company manuals, policies and rules
Multi-provider — Ports & Adapters to switch LLM models or vendors
Integrated back office — Order Kanban, multi-professional calendar, catalog with stock and CRM with customer history
Omnichannel inbox with human handoff — Real-time conversations over WebSockets; agents take over and hand control back to the AI
Message grouping — Joins sequential messages, simulates typing and respects business hours
Modular multi-tenancy by niche — Specific rules for restaurants, clinics and services, with RBAC access control
Analytics — Response time, AI latency, peak hours, contact reason classification and conversion
Architecture — React/TypeScript frontend (MVVM) and 7 Python/FastAPI microservices with Clean Architecture, orchestrated by events on RabbitMQ

Built with Clean Architecture, it integrates the Google Calendar API to create Google Meet rooms, a real-time anti-conflict scheduling engine, contract management with hour packages and a React and Vite interface based on the Gov.br Design System (WCAG 2.1 AA).
features: Anti-Conflict Scheduling Engine — Processes availability and prevents double-booking
Automatic Google Meet Rooms — Google Calendar API integration to create virtual rooms
Catalog and Contract Management — Lesson packages and hour balance control with automated debit
HttpOnly Cookie Security — Sessions protected against XSS with cryptographic tokens

url_shortener.title: Enterprise URL Shortener
url_shortener.description: URL shortening platform with Clean Architecture, secure authentication and malicious link checks.
url_shortener.overview: Backend system in Node.js (Fastify) and TypeScript, designed with Clean Architecture (Hexagonal), decoupling business rules, persistence (Sequelize/PostgreSQL) and web interfaces. It uses the Cache-Aside pattern with Redis for redirects and generates IDs with crypto.randomBytes (CSPRNG) and Base62 conversion.
features: ID Generation — crypto.randomBytes (CSPRNG) with Base62 conversion
Threat Intelligence — Safe Browsing provider with local blacklists and XSS and phishing detection
Authentication — ES256 JWT carried by HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Strict cookies
Argon2 Hashing — Key derivation resistant to GPU brute-force attacks
Redis Cache-Aside — Reduces database load on redirects
Race Condition Prevention — Handling of write collisions in the database
OpenAPI 3.0 Documentation — Interactive Swagger interface with cookieAuth support

store_api.title: Store API RESTful
store_api.description: RESTful API for e-commerce catalog and cart with Spring Boot, Redis and PostgreSQL.
store_api.overview: RESTful API in Java 21 and Spring Boot for e-commerce, with product catalog management, a shopping cart with distributed sessions on Redis and relational persistence on PostgreSQL. It has a layered architecture and runs in Docker containers.
features: Distributed Cart Management — Session storage with in-memory Redis
Product and Category Catalog — Full CRUD with pagination and entity validation
Authentication and Authorization — Access control with Spring Security and Bearer Token
Global Exception Handling — Standard error responses following RFC 7807, without exposing stack traces
Containerized Infrastructure — Automated environment with Docker and Docker Compose

spring_auth.title: Spring Boot Auth
spring_auth.description: Authentication and authorization REST API with Spring Security, asymmetric RSA256 JWT and HttpOnly cookies.
spring_auth.overview: Authentication and authorization REST API with Spring Boot 3 and Java 21 LTS. It implements role-based access control (RBAC) with three levels: Users, Roles and Privileges. Authentication uses JWT signed with asymmetric RSA256, delivered through HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Strict cookies to mitigate XSS, CSRF and token interception.
features: JWT with RSA256 — Asymmetric cryptography: the private key signs tokens and the public key validates them
Secure Cookies — HttpOnly, Secure (HTTPS-only) and SameSite=Strict flags to mitigate XSS and CSRF
Multi-Level RBAC — User → Role → Privilege hierarchy with granular permissions
Account Confirmation — Email activation with a UUID token
Async Email — Asynchronous sending with @EnableAsync, Spring Mail and Thymeleaf HTML templates
Global Exception Handler — Standard error responses that do not expose stack traces
Unit Tests — Services and business rules tested with JUnit 5 and Mockito
Multi-Stage Docker — JDK 21 build and Alpine JRE runtime with a non-root user
